units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 1:9">Targ. Koh. I, 9</cite> <he>לית כ׳</he> (h. text <he>אין כל</he>).—

Yalk. Num. 730 (ref. to Num. X, 35) מפניך … ואין אנו כ׳ לפניהם before thee they flee, and are we nothing before them? אלא כשפניך אתנו אנו כ׳ לפניהם וכשאין פניך אתנו אין אנו כ׳ לפניהם but (it means) when thy countenance is with us we are something before them &c.; Sifré Num. 84 (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 24:1">Kel. XXIV, 1</cite> <he>טהורה מכ׳</he> is clean from any (of the aforementioned impurities).
<cite ref="Berakhot 22b">Ber. 22ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>פטור מכ׳</he> is entirely exempt.
Ned. I, 1, a. fr. לא אמר כ׳ he has said nothing, i.e. what he said is void.—לא כ׳ not the least, nothing at all.
<cite ref="Eruvin 11a:15">Erub. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>לא עשה ולא כ׳</he> (Rashi <he>לא עשה כ׳</he>) he has done nothing at all, i.e. what he has done has no legal consequences.

<cite ref="Eruvin 11b:15">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>הכל מודין</he> … <he>לא כ׳ היא</he> Ms. M. all agree that if …, there is nothing at all (to consider; ed. <he>ולא כ׳</he> = <he>פטורה ולא כ׳</he> it is exempt, and there is nothing &c.); <cite ref="Yoma 11b:5">Yoma 11ᵇ</cite> <he>ולא כ׳</he> (<he>ולאו</he>) <he>היא</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. Ms. M. and note).—

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:10:1">Koh. R. to IX, 10</cite> <he>מאן הוא דכ׳ ודבר בגרמיה כ׳ וכ׳</he> if a person is somebody and comports himself as somebody (is proud of his value), it were better he had not been born; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (interrog.) introducing a question to which a negative answer is expected, is there any? has any? &c.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 105a:3">Snh. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ יש לזה על זה כ׳</he> has the one still any claim on the other? <cite ref="Shabbat 31a:9">Sabb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ מעמידין וכ׳</he> is there ever a king appointed except &c.? <cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 8:7">Ned. VIII, 7</cite> <he>כ׳ אמרת וכ׳</he> wouldst thou have said it, but for thy wish to honor me?; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 13:19">Tosef. Men. XIII, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 7:8">Tosef. B. Kam. VII, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="D00843"><he>דֶּלֶם</he></cite>.]
